# neoshowcase_application (Resource)

Creates and manages a NeoShowcase application, including its user-defined environment variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "neoshowcase_application" "example" {
  name          = "example"
  repository_id = neoshowcase_repository.example.id
  ref_name      = "main"
  running       = true

  build = {
    type          = "runtime_buildpack"
    context       = "."
    entrypoint    = "./server"
    use_mariadb   = true
    use_mongodb   = false
  }

  urls = [{
    fqdn           = "example.showcase.example.com"
    path_prefix    = "/"
    strip_prefix   = false
    https          = true
    h2c            = false
    http_port      = 3000
    authentication = "off"
  }]

  environment_variables = {
    APP_SECRET = {
      value_wo         = var.application_secret
      value_wo_version = 1
    }
  }

  additional_owner_ids = []
}

variable "application_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build` (Attributes) Build and deployment configuration. Fields not used by the selected type must keep their defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--build))
- `name` (String) Application display name.
- `ref_name` (String) Git ref built by NeoShowcase.
- `repository_id` (String) Repository used to build the application. NeoShowcase does not allow this value to be changed in place.

### Optional

- `additional_owner_ids` (Set of String) Exact set of owners managed in addition to the provider user.
- `environment_variables` (Attributes Map, Sensitive) Exact map of user-defined environment variables. Keys beginning with `NS_` are reserved for NeoShowcase. Values are write-only and never stored in Terraform state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_variables))
- `port_forwardings` (Attributes Set) Exact set of TCP or UDP port forwarding rules for the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--port_forwardings))
- `running` (Boolean) Desired application running state. The provider starts or stops the application to enforce this value.
- `urls` (Attributes Set) Exact set of HTTP or HTTPS access URLs exposed by the application. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--urls))

### Read-Only

- `authoritative_owner_id` (String) ID of the provider user, which must always remain an owner.
- `commit` (String) Current application commit.
- `container_message` (String) Current container status message.
- `container_state` (String) Current container state.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time in RFC 3339 format.
- `current_build_id` (String) Current build ID.
- `deploy_type` (String) Application deployment type reported by NeoShowcase.
- `effective_owner_ids` (Set of String) Actual owner set, including the authoritative provider user.
- `id` (String) NeoShowcase application ID.
- `latest_build_status` (String) Latest build status, when available.
- `system_environment_variable_keys` (Set of String) Keys of environment variables generated by NeoShowcase. Their values are deliberately not stored in state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
